newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo's Vobex, IBM in cooperation deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Yugo's Vobex, IBM in cooperation deal - paper.

text.p: Foreign trade firm VOBEX, a subsidiary of Vojvodjanska banka of Novi Sad, has signed a deal with IBM to market IBM personal computers and equipment in Yugoslavia, the newspaper Politika Ekspres reported on Wednesday.
The one-year contract, signed by VOBEX director Dragan Slijepcevic and IBM manager for Yugoslavia Mike Strang, promotes VOBEX into a "Class A" dealer for IBM personal computers and equipment.
Under the deal, VOBEX will market IBM computers and equipment primarily for the needs of banks, insurance and other financial organizations in Yugoslavia, the paper said.
The first major job will be renewing Vojvodjanska banka's computer equipment.
No-one at SBS IBM, IBM's general representative for Yugoslavia, or Vobex was immediately available for comment. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
